notes.title: Patch 1.7.8 release notes.
notes.notes:
A number of changes have been applied including:
1) moving the shuttle bay decompression chamber checkpoint further away from the door to fix spawning location issues.
2) reducing a large amount of unused files form the installation pack which has reduced the install size by nearly a gig!

Note - some players have reported an issue with the ACTIVATE and JUMP buttons being both mapped to E. This can be fixed by resetting mapping to defaults. If you are using a game controller, you also may find turning off Steam Controller input settings in Big Screen helpful.

Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.7.7 Patch released

notes.title: Sue's Story v1.7.3 patch released.
notes.notes:
This patch applies a few minor bug fixes, adds basic non-steam game controller support for movement and basic interaction, adds 55 secrets hidden throughout the levels, and additional achievements awarded when they are found.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37721991/0294ef1cc82ea05feac7b757251ecbd76ee45886.png[/img]

notes.title: Sue's Story v1.6.8 patch released.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

This patch fixes a few bugs which in some cases prevents a player from leaving the port cargo hold into the shuttle, as well as a few other minor bugs and tweaks.

An additional objective is added to help players find their way out of the very first cryochamber in the game!

Watch this space, we are adding XBOX controller support shortly.

notes.title: Version 1.6.6 Released
notes.notes:
A new patch has been released. This cleans up a number of small issues and defects, and hopefully improves gameplay experience.

Improvements include:
1) first person and 3rd person modes simplified with V toggle. first person forced in crouch spaces, ladders and combat,.
2) how forced crouched spaces work
3) backpack volume/weight management simplified and some bugs fixed
4) improvements to ladder climbing camera control
5) numerous little fixes and tweaks to levels

notes.title: Sue's Story 1.4.1 Patch released
notes.notes:
This patch fixes the problem with the headset in the shuttle not being able to be picked up, as well as some key access cards on the Starboard for driving the forklift.

Enjoy!
